mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of the Foreign Investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent Company Registry in the Foreign Investor's Jurisdiction of Incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Mutually exclusive authentication paths: (1) Hague Apostille path - notarized extract certified by the Designated Competent Authority under the Hague Apostille Convention; (2) Non-Hague Consular path - notarized extract certified by the host-country foreign affairs authority and subsequently legalized by the Chinese Embassy or Consulate in that country. Apostille and consular legalization must never be combined for the same instrument.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent Company Registry in the Foreign Investor's Jurisdiction of Incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Mutually exclusive authentication paths: (1) Hague Apostille path - notarized certificate certified by the Designated Competent Authority under the Hague Apostille Convention; (2) Non-Hague Consular path - notarized certificate certified by the host-country foreign affairs authority and subsequently legalized by the Chinese Embassy or Consulate in that country. Apostille and consular legalization must never be combined for the same instrument.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified True Copy of Board Resolution and Power of Attorney Appointing the WFOE's Legal Representative and Registered Agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of Directors of the Foreign Investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Mutually exclusive authentication paths: (1) Hague Apostille path - notarized certified copy apostilled by the Designated Competent Authority of the country of origin; (2) Non-Hague Consular path - notarized certified copy legalized by the Chinese Embassy or Consulate after host-country foreign affairs authentication. Apostille and consular legalization must never be combined sequentially.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association or Constitutional Documents of the Foreign Investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign Investor or Competent Company Registry in the Foreign Investor's Jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Mutually exclusive authentication paths: (1) Hague Apostille path - notarized copy apostilled by the Designated Competent Authority in the country of origin; (2) Non-Hague Consular path - notarized copy legalized by the Chinese Embassy or Consulate after host-country foreign affairs authentication. Apostille and consular legalization must never be combined sequentially.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter for the Foreign Investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Mutually exclusive authentication paths: (1) Hague Apostille path - original bank letter notarized and apostilled in the country of origin; (2) Non-Hague Consular path - original bank letter notarized, authorized by the host-country foreign ministry, then legalized by the Chinese Embassy or Consulate. Apostille and consular legalization must never be combined sequentially; the letter must be dated within 90 days before submission.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency or Register of Directors and UBOs
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registered Agent or Competent Company Registry of the Foreign Investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Mutually exclusive authentication paths: (1) Hague Apostille path - certified extract apostilled by the Designated Competent Authority in the country of origin; (2) Non-Hague Consular path - certified extract legalized by the Chinese Embassy or Consulate after host-country foreign affairs authentication. Apostille and consular legalization must never be combined sequentially.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: The WFOE investor, all UBOs, directors, legal representatives, and authorized signatories must be screened against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals List, OFAC Non-SDN Consolidated List, UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and China's domestic AML/CFT sanctions lists. PEP screening must cover the individual, immediate family members, and known close associates using a risk-based approach; enhanced due diligence, independent source-of-wealth verification, and senior-management approval are mandatory for high-risk PEPs. Continuous transaction monitoring and quarterly re-screening are required throughout the formation stage and ongoing operations.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: SAMR National Enterprise Name Registration Management System (National Enterprise Name Declaration Platform) maintained by the State Administration for Market Regulation and operated through provincial and municipal Market Regulation Administration e-portals
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Mandarin Chinese is the statutory language for company registration. The WFOE name must follow the four-tier structure: administrative division plus distinctive name plus industry or business characteristics plus liability form. Names for a wholly foreign-owned enterprise must be declared in Chinese characters; where the foreign investor brand is in non-Chinese script, a Mandarin phonetic transliteration in Pinyin must be supplied for the distinctive name, and any adopted English name is for commercial use only and does not replace the statutory Chinese name. The Chinese name must not be identical or confusingly similar to previously registered enterprise names, trademarks, or public institution names.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon receiving a name rejection, the applicant must request a written decision citing the objective basis. Within 60 days from receipt, the applicant may file administrative reconsideration with the upper-level market regulation administration, or alternatively commence an administrative lawsuit at the competent People's Court within six months. The reconsideration application must include the original rejection notice, the applicant's identity documents, a corrected four-tier name, and supporting evidence of trademark rights; simultaneous submission of a fresh name declaration is permitted to prevent operational delay.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: For ISIC 3240 toy manufacturing WFOE, a virtual office or commercial mailbox is not permissible as the registered office. The State Taxation Administration and local tax offices reject virtual addresses for taxpayer registration and general VAT invoice issuance; PBOC-regulated banks require a physical due-diligence visit and will decline account opening where no operating premises exist. A commercial mailbox may be used only as a supplementary correspondence address. The WFOE must secure a fixed industrial or commercial lease or wholly owned premises before incorporation and must display its name plaque at that address.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Checklist: (1) valid lease in the WFOE's name; (2) production or warehousing fixtures; (3) employee presence during business hours; (4) company signboard at the registered door; (5) fire-safety, environmental, and product-safety permits; (6) on-site matching of invoices, books, and inventory. Quantified risk: 65-75% likelihood of unannounced municipal tax or SAMR inspection within the first 12 months unless active manufacturing is verified; 35-45% likelihood if production is fully active and personnel are on site. Municipalities such as Shanghai, Beijing, and Shenzhen conduct risk-based inspections at 40-60% intensity for foreign-invested manufacturing registrants without physical inventory.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (Revised 2023), Articles 23, 24, 30-32, 36-38 and 80; Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (2020), Articles 2, 12 and 16; Regulations on the Administration of Foreign-Invested Company Registration (SAMR Decree No. 68)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR), Enterprise Registration Bureau, through the local municipal and district-level SAMR market regulation windows or the online National Enterprise Registration Service portal
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Establishment Registration of a Foreign-Funded Limited Liability Company (consolidated with the Articles of Association and business license application)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: None. China abolished the minimum paid-in capital for general foreign-invested WFOEs. The sole shareholder must subscribe the registered capital within the term specified in the Articles of Association, not exceeding 10 years, and may register with zero paid-in capital subject to authenticity and transparency. No mandatory blocked escrow account exists; however, the capital contribution escrow procedure used for share subscription payments is standard for company banking.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED by the Board of Directors of CN_WFOE_LTD (the Company) held legally and validly at the registered office on the date mentioned in the meeting minutes: 1. Approval of Constitutional Documents. The Board ratifies the execution and filing of the Articles of Association, the Sole Shareholder Decision, and the Application for Establishment Registration of a wholly foreign-owned limited liability company under the PRC Foreign Investment Law. The Board confirms that the legal representative shall execute on behalf of the Company all instruments mandatory under law. 2. Share Capital Subscription and Corporate Bookkeeping. The registered share capital of the Company shall be CNY 5,000,000 divided into 5,000,000 ordinary shares of CNY 1.00 each. The Board unanimously approves the full subscription of the share capital by the sole shareholder, who undertakes to pay the subscribed amount in cash into the capital contribution deposit account to be opened for that purpose, subject to the time limits for contribution specified in the Articles not exceeding ten years. The financial officer is instructed to maintain an escrow ledger for such contributions and to ensure proper segregation of shareholder funds with our banks. 3. Registered Office. The Board approves the adoption of the premises located at the municipal wood industrial zone address as the registered office of the Company. The Chairman of the Board is authorized to sign the lease agreement, pay outstanding deposits, and file the statutory address declaration with the SAMR; on establishment, the Company must accept all lawful postal and legal processes at that address. 4. Appointment of Officers. The following persons are hereby appointed to the statutory and leading positions of the Company: the designated director as Chairman and Legal Representative; the designated general manager as General Manager; the designated financial officer as Financial Officer, with the controller function; and a designated supervisor as Supervisor, in compliance with the PRC Company Law. Each officer has the authority to sign contracts, open accounts, employ staff, and apply for licenses within the scope of the Company. 5. Banking Arrangements. The Board authorizes the Financial Officer, with a second signature of the General Manager, to open a basic RMB settlement account, a foreign currency account, and a working capital account with a PBOC-licensed bank. The bank shall be given an original of this resolution, and the account mandate includes two-signature requirement for sums exceeding CNY 100,000, making a correct security arrangement. 6. Seal and Forgeries. The Board authorizes the carving and reservation of the official company seal, finance seal, invoice seal, contract seal, and legal representative seal; these seals are kept under the control of the General Manager, placed in dual custody. No officer shall use any seal outside the ordinary course of business. 7. Acquisition of Industrial Licenses and Environmental Approvals. The Board directs the management to apply, before any production begins, for the environmental impact assessment filing, fire safety inspection, occupational hazard monitoring, product-quality self-conformity certificate under GB 6675-2014, and any possible pollutant discharge permits. All applications shall be made through competent authorities. 8. Ratification of Prior Acts. The Board ratifies all acts previously done by the promoters, registration agent, and attorneys in establishing the Company and obtaining the unified social credit code. 9. Effective Date and Records. This resolution takes effect as of the date it is signed, and a signed copy shall be delivered to the SAMR, the bank, and the tax authorities upon request. The Secretary shall deposit the resolution in the corporate minute book. Approved and certified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Business Scope Vetting
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipal SAMR online Enterprise Registration Administration System (via the local market regulation bureau one-stop portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct pre-registration name and scope verification. The proposed company trade name must follow the format: jurisdiction plus unique distinguishing name plus industry characteristic plus company type, for example, Shanghai EcoToys Co., Ltd. The applicant shall submit three alternative names through the SAMR online name reservation channel, specifying the child categories under the industrial classification covering manufacture of wooden toys (industry code C2452). The submitted business scope must accurately include the manufacture and processing of beechwood toy blocks, sanding, non-toxic water-based coating, assembly, branding, wholesale, retail, and export. Authorization letters from the foreign shareholder and duly notarized and legalized certificates are required. Review of trademark conflicts is carried out on the same portal. Submit the name reservation application and await preliminary clearance to guarantee no adverse reports.
required_dossiers: Name reservation application form
Articles of Association draft
Foreign shareholder identification and enterprise registration proof
Legal representation appointment letter
Proposed business scope description and ISIC mapping
Non-conflict trademark undertaking
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused due to identical or similar existing marks, submit a new set of alternative names within 10 working days or initiate an administrative review through the SAMR complaint window. If the business scope is questioned, modify the scope description to conform to the Catalogue of Negative Items and submit an explanatory note.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Establishment Registration and Domicile Filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: District-level Market Regulation Administration (SAMR) acceptance window; online submission through the National Enterprise Registration Service portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Incorporate the Company by filing the complete establishment dossier. The sole shareholder shall execute the Articles of Association and pass a sole shareholder decision appointing the first board members. Foreign corporate documents such as shareholder certificate and resolution must be notarized in the home jurisdiction and legalized by the PRC Embassy or Consulate; foreign individual documents must be notarized and certified. The application shall be filed electronically, and the paper dossier, whether bilingual or Chinese, delivered to the SAMR business reception. The lease or service agreement for the registered office, which must be a commercial administrative address, shall be provided with property ownership proof and landlord identification. After the SAMR verifies the name, lawful objects, contributions, legal representative, and domicile, it will issue the Business License with Unified Social Credit Code. The registered office shall be reserved for at least three years, or an approved industrial address is acceptable to satisfy the condition.
required_dossiers: Notarized and legalized foreign shareholder corpus documents
Articles of Association duly signed by all shareholders
Certificate of subscription and paid-in capital undertaking verified by accountant or self-declaration
Lease contract and property ownership certificate for the registered address
Identity documents of the legal representatives and supervisors
Application for WFOE establishment registration form
Execution by the legal representative and the sole shareholder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If SAMR issues a supplementary materials notice, correct deficiencies within 15 calendar days; if the application is rejected, the applicant may appeal to the higher SAMR administrative reconsideration stage. Unremedied queries automatically suspend the dossier and may require new notarization.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax, Social Security and Foreign Exchange Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: State Taxation Administration local Municipal Tax Service, local Municipal Social Insurance Agency, and State Administration of Foreign Exchange through default bank transfer
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After receiving the Unified Social Credit Code, the WFOE must, within thirty days, complete tax registration at the Municipal Tax Service office, obtaining Tax Identification Number, VAT payer status whether general or small-scale, invoice layout and export tax rebate registration. Simultaneously register with the social insurance and housing provident fund agencies to designate contribution schedules for employees. For the foreign exchange side, the Company shall open a capital account at a designated bank after SAFE automatic registration under the foreign-invested enterprise registration framework. The financial officer must apply for bank online banking and treasury approval authority. The tax filing package shall include the establishment documents already issued. This step ensures the company can lawfully issue invoices to platforms such as Amazon and Stripe.
required_dossiers: Business License
Company seal and finance seal
Legal representative ID
Completed tax registration form and taxpayer information form
Articles of Association and shareholder identification
Bank account opening license or credential
Social insurance registration form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If tax registration delay occurs, the company must apply for extenuating circumstances at the Tax Service with an explanation and pay a penalty not exceeding CNY 10,000 if overdue; expedited registration can be obtained through one-window integrated services. For SAFE mismatch, apply for correction within ten days by presenting bank custody agreements.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening Bank Accounts and Injecting Capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: PBOC-licensed commercial banks such as Industrial and Commercial Bank of China or Bank of China; SAFE-delegated banks
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open the basic RMB and foreign currency settlement accounts with the bank cross-border business department. Submit the notarized corporate documents, business license, and Articles to the bank. For the capital account, obtain SAFE recipient registration and open a capital deposit account. After the account is set, the sole shareholder transfers subscribed capital in accordance with the payment schedule in the Articles. Each receipt must be matched to the capital contribution remittance certificate. A seasoned CPA verifies the capital injection and issues a capital verification report upon notice. Part of the funds is retained in a restricted escrow account for production equipment, wood procurement, and environmental health and safety licenses. The CFO should request bank card acquirer services for Amazon Pay and Stripe rails.
required_dossiers: Business License original
Chop and legal representative identity
Foreign shareholder remittance statements
Fully executed Articles of Association
Seal card for banking transactions
SAFE foreign-invested enterprise registration completed form
Working budget and procurement plan
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank interview raises doubts, supply additional source-of-funds evidence such as bank statements or equity certificates. If SAFE registration fails, reapply through the bank SAFE online one-stop interface. Capital contributions withdrawn in non-purpose currencies may be sanctioned.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Industrial Permitting (EIA, Fire and Occupational Safety) Pre-operational Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipal Bureau of Ecology and Environment, Fire and Rescue Division of the Ministry of Emergency Management, and Workplace Safety Administration
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prior to installation of machinery and the beginning of manufacturing, file the Environmental Impact Assessment Registration Form for wood processing and wooden toy assembly. If pollution thresholds cross certain parameters, submit a report to the Ecological Environment Bureau. Prepare fire prevention system drawings and inspect the factory fire lanes, extinguishers, and emergency exits; obtain the Fire Safety Inspection Certificate after passing the China Fire Protection audit. Undertake occupational hazard pre-evaluation in respect of wood dust and noise, and set up ventilation and dust collection equipment. Secure a pollutant discharge permit from the municipal bureau if there are any process wastewater discharges. The authorities shall inspect and approve within ten working days after all devices are in place.
required_dossiers: EIA filing or registration form
Factory layout map and lease or ownership proof
Fire prevention design statement with stamped fire department forms
Ventilation design plan and wood dust testing report
List of production machines and capacity
Occupational hazard pre-assessment report
Pollutant discharge permit application if applicable
Copy of the Business License
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the fire inspection fails, correct defects and reopen inspection, potentially facing a fine up to CNY 50,000 and suspension of production. If EIA grading is raised by environmental bodies, undergo a full environmental impact report and amend the classification within the prescribed time. Appeals may be made to the municipal government review.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Municipal Bureau of Industry and Information Technology, Municipal Ecology and Environment Bureau, Fire and Rescue Department of the Ministry of Emergency Management, and Occupational Health and Safety Supervision Administration under the Ministry of Emergency Management
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Toy Manufacturing Business License (from SAMR); Fire Safety Acceptance Certificate (from Fire and Rescue); Environmental Impact Assessment Filing or Report Approval (from Municipal Ecology and Environment Bureau); Pollutant Discharge Permit (if applicable); Product Quality Compliance Certificate under Mandatory Product Standard GB 6675-2014

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Municipal Ecology and Environment Bureau (MEE) and Provincial Department of Ecology and Environment
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Environmental Registration (Filing) Level for simple wood cutting, sanding and non-toxic water-based coating of toys; if solvent-based paints are used or VOC emissions exceed 1 kg per hour, then Classification Report Form (Report Book) required with a full EIA Report; final grade determined by the MEE Classification List for Construction Projects (2019)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater COD less than or equal to 100 mg/L, ammonia nitrogen less than or equal to 15 mg/L, pH 6 to 9; volatile organic compounds at exhaust inlet less than or equal to 500 mg per cubic meter and surface coating workshop less than or equal to 60 mg per cubic meter; total suspended particles from wood dust less than or equal to 2 mg per cubic meter in breathing zone; noise at factory boundary less than or equal to 65 dB(A) daytime and 55 dB(A) night; hazardous waste such as solvent residue or spent filters shall be stored in sealed containers, labeled, and handed to a licensed hazardous waste processor within one year.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Inspection Certificate for fire proofing of workshop and warehouse, Structural Load Certification for the plant floor, and Occupational Hazard Assessment including noise, dust and chemical exposure monitoring to be completed before commissioning. The factory must also hold a workplace safety training certificate for key personnel and an emergency response plan filed with the Civil Defense authority.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) of the People's Republic of China. Electronic filing is performed through the National Electronic Tax Bureau (e-Tax Bureau) portal maintained by the STA and operated through provincial e-Tax Bureau sub-portals.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The WFOE is a Chinese resident limited liability company and must obtain a Unified Social Credit Code (USCC) through the Administration for Market Regulation (AMR) at incorporation. Procedure: (i) file the articles of association, shareholder identity documentation, registered capital, business scope (ISIC 3240 toy manufacturing and export), and proposed directors with the competent AMR via the government service online portal; (ii) receive the Business License bearing the USCC, which is the sole statutory tax identification number for both enterprise income tax and VAT; (iii) rely on the automatic data synchronization between AMR and STA under the multi-license integration reform to complete the initial taxpayer registration; (iv) within 30 days of license issuance, sign into the Electronic Tax Bureau with real-name authentication to complete supplementary taxpayer registration—legal representative, accounting details, bank account, invoice-issuing personnel, expected turnover, and export-tax-refund (export VAT rebate) status; and (v) for foreign non-resident entities without a Chinese establishment, no separate USCC is issued; the Chinese counterparty or withholding agent registers the non-resident in the VAT/enterprise income tax withholding module and obtains a non-resident taxpayer identification number for treaty and withholding purposes.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. The People's Republic of China does not provide US-style check-the-box elections, pass-through entity elections, or hybrid entity classifications. A WFOE is mandatorily taxed as an entity-level resident enterprise taxpayer; anti-hybrid mismatch rules and tax treaty provisions apply.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: All WFOEs must complete tax registration regardless of turnover. The VAT general taxpayer classification threshold is RMB 5,000,000 of annual taxable sales (measured over any consecutive 12-month period); if the threshold is exceeded, mandatory registration as a VAT general taxpayer applies. Below that threshold, the entity may remain a small-scale VAT taxpayer, and small-scale taxpayers enjoy an exemption for monthly taxable sales up to RMB 100,000 (quarterly RMB 300,000).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: China mandates real-time issuance and reporting of electronic VAT invoices through the STA Golden Tax Phase IV system and the Unified Electronic Invoice Service Platform. The WFOE must issue Full Digital Electronic Invoices (FDEI) with an anti-fraud digital tax-control stamp or, for affected legacy scenarios, tax-controlled special/ordinary VAT invoices through approved e-invoicing software. Invoice data must be transmitted to STA servers in real-time or near-real-time for fiscal clearance, verification, and matching; ERP or billing-system integration is performed through STA-certified APIs. Buyers and tax authorities validate invoices using the National VAT Invoice Verification Platform; any mismatch, duplicate, or abnormal invoice is automatically flagged for anti-fraud inspection.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A registered VAT general taxpayer may apply 0% VAT to tangible goods that are actually exported from China customs territory and sold to a non-resident buyer, provided the export customs declaration is completed, the goods physically leave China, the exporter holds valid VAT input invoices on the purchased goods, and the corresponding export proceeds are repatriated to China through approved banking channels within the statutory deadline. Qualifying cross-border services or offshore digital services are zero-rated only when rendered to non-resident enterprises, consumed wholly outside China, and evidenced by the prescribed service export documentary package.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Electronic Customs Export Goods Declaration (export manifest declaration number from the China International Trade Single Window);
Ocean Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing goods release from China;
Commercial invoice and packing list on the WFOE letterhead;
Export VAT rebate declaration together with upstream VAT special invoices proving domestic input VAT;
Bank-issued export proceeds receipt / Inward Remittance Certificate (or equivalent Foreign-Currency Income Declaration and settlement water note) demonstrating foreign-exchange repatriation.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating is subject to retrospective STA audit. If the STA finds a false, incomplete, or unsupported export declaration, missing foreign-exchange repatriation, counterfeit invoices, round-tripping, or fictitious cross-border transactions, it will claw back the claimed VAT rebate, impose a daily late-payment surcharge at 0.05% of the unpaid tax, and levy a penalty of 50% to 500% of the evaded tax under the Tax Collection Administration Law of the People's Republic of China. Fraudulent export-tax-rebate claims also constitute a criminal offense under Article 204 of the PRC Criminal Law, punishable by imprisonment up to life plus confiscation of property. Additional administrative consequences include downgrade of the tax credit rating, suspension of export rebate eligibility, mandatory full-documentary on-site inspection, and inclusion on the joint disciplinary 'serious tax dishonesty' blacklist; the coercive collection period is unlimited in fraud cases.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange of the People's Republic of China (SAFE), under the People's Bank of China (PBOC)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: China operates a managed float regime under the People's Bank of China and SAFE with strict bifurcation. Current account transactions—export/import payments, fees, royalties, and arm's-length service payments—are in principle freely convertible, subject to transactional authenticity documents and anti-fraud review by designated banks. Capital account transactions, including the original injection of equity capital into a WFOE, the conversion of foreign exchange for registered capital, domestic reinvestment, and ultimate profit remittance to overseas shareholders, remain controlled. A WFOE must register its FDI capital with SAFE through a designated bank, maintain a dedicated capital escrow account, and expend funds within the approved negative-list business scope. Profit remittance requires annual audited financial statements, an underlying board resolution approving distribution, a Chinese mainland tax clearance demonstration (corporate income tax withholding certificate), and bank documentation proving funds originate from after-tax retained earnings. Although current-account payments enjoy no mandatory surrender ratio, the principle of 'real demand, not speculation' dominates, so a WFOE must present contracts, invoices, customs declarations, and customs manifests to convert currency in either direction.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: SAFE's current framework sets no mandatory conversion percentage. A WFOE must repatriate export receipts generated by cross-border trade through a designated FX bank within 180 days after export declaration or the relevant collection due date; any delay requires a justification and extension filing. Once the USD, EUR, or other proceeds arrive in the WFOE's foreign exchange settlement account, the company may voluntarily convert 100% to CNY at market rates or retain 100% in foreign currency, subject to authenticity review and trade monitoring system reporting. Non-trade service export proceeds follow contract/service completion evidence and do not require customs declaration. Failure to timely repatriate or report may trigger SAFE penalties and removal of the batch-verification convenience.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Offshore digital EMI platforms such as Wise, Revolut Business, or Fintech-as-a-bank providers have no bank license from the PBOC/CBIRC and cannot open virtual current accounts for mainland WFOEs, issue CN domiciliation codes, or perform CNY clearing. Amazon Pay and Stripe can only operate as offshore collection rails into which the WFOE's overseas sales are drawn, but the proceeds must ultimately be remitted to a SAFE-monitored account through licensed cross-border payment institutions or a commercial bank. A WFOE cannot rely on these EMIs as the financial institution of record for statutory tax clearance, capital verification, or export proceeds surrender. Viability: very low as a primary banking solution; permissible only as front-end e-commerce collection aggregators, and even then the aggregator must hold a PBOC cross-border payment clearance license or be serviced by a licensed Chinese bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: PBOC and commercial bank internal policies generally require physical presence of the WFOE's legal representative (the statutory director of the Chinese entity) at least once during the initial account opening interview, especially for the RMB basic deposit account and the FDI capital account. The passport must be genuine, biometric verification performed in-branch, and the legal representative executed the bank resolution. Remote video or notarized consular proxy is not accepted as a full alternative for the mandatory face-to-face interview; however, authorized financial personnel may complete subsequent operational formalities under an authenticated power of attorney. Some banks allow the legal representative to appoint a local financial manager after an initial in-branch meeting, but the opening signature and Q&A with a compliance officer remain mandatory for the WFOE.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border shareholder is an offshore holding company without open business operations, producing opaque ultimate beneficial ownership and unclear economic substance.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Duly apostilled or consul-legalized Articles of Association, shareholder register, UBO declaration, organizational chart, audited financial statements of the ultimate parent, source-of-wealth report for each UBO, bank reference letter from the home jurisdiction, and a notarized resolution appointing the local legal representative.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Mismatch between declared business scope (wooden toy manufacturing and export) and high-frequency remittance through e-commerce marketplaces such as Amazon and Stripe, which may indicate trade-based money laundering or over/under-invoicing.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sample purchase orders, customs export declarations, bill of lading/air waybill, full inventory and factory production records, raw material purchase contracts, VAT invoice reconciliation, marketplace settlement reports, logistics trackers, and trademark/licensing agreements proving actual manufacture and commercial substance.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear provenance of inbound FDI capital into the capital account, especially private investor transfers originating from personal accounts or low-tax jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bank statements covering 12 months, official payroll or dividend distribution evidence, personal tax returns, audited health of the investing company, notarized declaration of lawful income, transactional path explanation, and if necessary a dual CPAs source-of-funds verification and legal opinion on offshore corporate law.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of payment aggregators/EMIs as intermediaries that obscure the ultimate payer identity and prevent the bank from assessing intended payment profile.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed agreement with the payment provider, platform KYC and merchant verification excerpts, authorization chain from marketplace payout to WFOE bank, consolidated settlement statements showing payer-level transaction IDs, refund/voucher policies, and a written representation that no third-party collection or wallet-to-wallet bypass is used.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Initial FDI capital should be remitted by SWIFT MT103 from the registered foreign investor's corporate bank account to the WFOE's dedicated capital escrow account at a domestic Tier-1 bank. The remittance instruction must include the correct foreign exchange purpose code for foreign direct investment equity injection and reference the SAFE FDI registration/QR code. The bank validates authenticity, converts funds at market rate or retains foreign currency per the capital account cap, records the capital verification via a local CPA certificate, and updates the SAFE digital system. No payment can be made from the capital account for non-business purposes or before negative-list review. For multiple injections, the investor must remit within the registered capital schedule and obtain a renewed capital verification and SAFE update.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound payments for imported raw materials and operating expenses must clear through the WFOE's ordinary current account at a licensed bank. The preferred rail is SWIFT MT103 with mandatory supporting documents (import declaration, invoice, contract, transport documents). For significant trade flows, Commercial Letters of Credit issued by the buyer's bank can be advised and confirmed through the domestic bank; Documentary Collections (D/P and D/A) may be used where a clean LC is not available. RMB-denominated counterparties in strategic jurisdictions should be routed through CIPS with SWIFT-compatible messaging. The same bank must perform authenticity reviews, report to SAFE, and maintain export/import monitoring.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable forward FX contracts with a licensed bank under SAFE's real-demand rule, limited to actual trade or capital-exposure amounts.
Currency swaps for hedging of foreign-currency debt, equity capital conversion exposure, and cross-currency operational cash flows over a notional equal to the underlying commitment.
FX options on CNY/foreign pairs for hedging, subject to the absence of net speculative positioning and documentary submission of underlying trade contracts.

Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are not legally available to a mainland WFOE as a direct customer; a compliant alternative is to manage residual FX risk through the onshore forward market or structural pricing in export contracts.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Enterprise Information Publicity Report (annual return filed on the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) / local Administration for Market Regulation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 1 through June 30 of each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to publish by June 30 places the WFOE on the Operating Exception List within 10 working days; if the default continues for 3 consecutive years, the WFOE is transferred to the Serious Illegal and Dishonest Enterprise List and the SAMR may administratively strike off the license after statutory procedure, while the legal representative and liable officers receive a 3-year market-entry ban and joint credit discipline.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Final Settlement and Annual EIT Return (reconciliation of quarterly prepayments)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) / local competent tax authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before May 31 immediately following each tax year (fiscal year January 1 - December 31)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of RMB 2,000 to RMB 10,000; daily late-payment surcharge of 0.05% on overdue tax; understatement or tax evasion penalty of 50% to 100% (or up to 300% for evasion) of the tax fraudulently unpaid; continuous serious arrears trigger accelerated administrative enforcement, asset freezing, credit downgrade, and administrative strike-off after the statutory deregistration process is completed.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Foreign Investment Information Report (foreign-invested enterprise annual investment information filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) through the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System operated by SAMR (single-window data sharing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 1 through June 30 of each calendar year, with a 30-day post-event reporting window for shareholding, actual-controller, and investment-amount changes
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file, late filing, or inaccurate filing triggers a 30-day correction order; if not corrected, MOFCOM may impose a fine of RMB 100,000 to RMB 500,000, record the non-compliance in the foreign-investment credit archive, disqualify preferential foreign-investment treatment, and cause joint administrative monitoring that can ultimately support administrative deregistration.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Under PRC Company Law, the WFOE is unconditionally required to have its annual financial statements audited by a PRC-certified CPA firm; no de-minimis threshold based on balance-sheet size, turnover, or headcount exempts the entity. A one-shareholder WFOE is expressly audit-mandated as a one-person limited liability company. For classification reference, the PRC SME classification for manufacturing uses headcount and turnover bands (micro: fewer than 20 employees or revenue below RMB 3 million; small: 20-299 employees and revenue RMB 3-20 million; medium: 300-999 employees and revenue RMB 20-400 million; large: 1,000+ employees or revenue above RMB 400 million), and medium/large manufacturing WFOEs are expected to present full-CAS audited statements for financing, customs, and tax purposes, though the statutory audit duty itself is not conditioned on those thresholds.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: PRC Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (CAS/ASBE), substantially converged with IFRS; qualifying small enterprises may alternatively apply the simplified Enterprise Accounting Standards for Small Enterprises (CAS-SME), but a WFOE engaged in cross-border Amazon/Stripe e-commerce and related-party supply-chain transactions should consistently apply full CAS with RMB reporting and Chinese-language books.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: China uses an integrated annual reporting mechanism rather than a standalone UBO confirmation statement. The WFOE must identify its ultimate beneficial owner/actual controller in the Annual Foreign Investment Information Report filed January 1 through June 30; any shareholding transfer or actual-controller change must be filed through the SAMR enterprise registration change procedure and the foreign-investment information filing system within 30 calendar days of the event. The beneficial-owner identification record must be maintained internally for AML inspection and must match the annual report; no separate filing fee is charged.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$600 - US$2,500 per year for a compliant commercial registered address in Tier-1 cities plus professional corporate secretarial/registered-address services; incubator-zone addresses are available at the lower end.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$2,000 - US$6,500 per year for a small-to-medium manufacturing WFOE, increasing to US$8,000 - US$15,000 when transfer pricing documentation, related-party transactions, cross-border inventory, and toy-product statutory compliance reviews are included.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Qualifying high-tech enterprises may apply a reduced 15% rate; Qualified Small Low-Profit Enterprises may apply the preferential 20% rate with effective taxable-income-tier reductions (e.g., 2.5% for low brackets); Manufacturing WFOEs engaged in R&D can deduct 100% of qualifying R&D expenses as an additional super-deduction; certain Software/Western-Region enterprises may enjoy 15% or regional tax holidays; fresh equipment/accelerated depreciation may be claimed in permitted sectors.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form A200000 - Corporate Income Tax Annual Return (A Class), filed on-line through the State Taxation Administration's Electronic Tax Bureau (e-tax portal, chinatax.gov.cn or provincial digital tax platforms).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual (with mandatory quarterly provisional prepayments, due within 15 days after the end of each quarter).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Final annual return due on or before 31 May of the following calendar year (5 months after the fiscal year-end); quarterly prepayments are required within 15 days from quarter-end; overdue annual returns trigger automated late-filing penalties.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer identity, national unified social credit code, registered address, legal representative, share capital, ultimate beneficial owner information, and industrial classification (ISIC 3240).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Fully disclose the foreign parent's jurisdiction of residence and equity percentage. Non-resident enterprises are not subject to corporate income tax (CIT) on commercial activity unless they derive Chinese-source profits; a pure investment holding by a non-resident is taxed at 10% withholding on dividends, interest, royalties, and rental income unless reduced by a Double Tax Agreement (DTA).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Accounting net profit computed under the PRC Accounting Standards, integrating all revenue from Amazon Pay, Stripe, B2B wholesale, and domestic sales channels.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: All cross-border e-commerce revenue must be booked at gross sale value in RMB; double-check that outbound logistics fees, platform commissions, and refunds are properly itemized. The tax authority will cross-match with customs declarations and payment-rail records from Amazon Pay and Stripe; any off-book sales constitute tax evasion.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income adjustments: add-back of non-deductible expenditures, penalties, non-business expenses, excessive entertainment expenses, and accrued withholding tax; deduction of allowable research and development costs, asset impairments, and prior-year tax losses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident head-office fees recharged to the WFOE must satisfy a documented cost-sharing or service agreement, be in compliance with the arm's-length principle, and be supported by an invoice or equivalent documentation; otherwise the tax authority may disallow such deductions and treat the payments as Chinese-source service income subject to 10% withholding.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Amount of taxable income after statutory loss carry-forwards and before applying the preferential tax rate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Losses may be carried forward for 5 years only; any loss expiry event must be tracked. If the WFOE is a single-activity toy manufacturing entity, careful allocation with related-party transactions is mandatory; the taxpayer must maintain a clear arm's-length analysis to avoid a recharacterized profit distribution.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Applicable CIT rate and tax payable: standard 25%, reduced 20% for Small Low-Profit Enterprises, or 15% for High/New Technology Enterprises.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claiming preferential or treaty-related tax treatment is not automatic; the WFOE must register the qualifying status before filing and maintain contemporaneous evidence. An otherwise applicable 15% high-tech rate may be denied if the taxpayer fails to file annual qualification documents, which increases the effective parent-country credit exposure.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Foreign tax credits, domestic tax credits, special tax adjustments, and withholding tax declarations on profit repatriation, interest, royalties, and related-party receipts.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The WFOE acts as the statutory withholding agent for outbound dividends, interest, royalties, and technical-service fees paid to non-resident shareholders. The domestic withholding rate is 10%; a 5% reduced dividend rate or other treaty rate can be applied only when the non-resident supplies a valid Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) and completes a Beneficial Ownership statement, and the item of income is actually attributable to a non-resident without a permanent establishment in China.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Related-party transaction disclosure schedule (RPT schedule): consolidated amounts of tangible-asset sales, intangible-asset transfers, inter company loans, services, and royalties with related parties worldwide.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Mandatory every year irrespective of size, but contemporaneous Local File preparation is required when annual related-party transactions exceed: RMB 200 million for tangible property, RMB 100 million for intangible property, RMB 100 million for financial assets, or RMB 40 million for services. Master File documentation is triggered when cross-border related-party transactions exceed RMB 1 billion. Failure to file causes a transfer-pricing audit presumption and a 5% documentation penalty cap.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final tax due liability, overpayment refund claim, or carry-forward credit after all adjustments and quarterly prepayments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Ensure that provisional quarterly payments have been fully credited; any underpayment attracts daily interest of 0.05%; tax evasion—including deliberately omitting revenue received via Amazon Pay or Stripe—is punishable under Article 201 of the Criminal Law with imprisonment for up to 7 years, in addition to penalties of 50%-5 times the evasion amount.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: statutory fine of RMB 2,000, or RMB 2,000-10,000 after a demand notice; late payment daily surcharge of 0.05% on unpaid tax; under-declaration negligence penalty of 50%-5 times the tax evaded; false invoicing or fraudulent refund claims triggers tax collection and penalty proceedings, and criminal tax evasion can result in up to 7 years' imprisonment and up to RMB 500,000 fine; directors and legal representatives are subject to exit bans (blacklisting) and personal asset preservation.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% (domestic statutory rate under the PRC Enterprise Income Tax Law, Article 3(3); the rate is automatically reduced to 5% under many comprehensive DTAs if the recipient holds at least 25% of the Chinese payer's shares and qualifies as the beneficial owner.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To secure DTA relief, the non-resident shareholder must: (1) obtain a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from the home-country tax authority; (2) provide a Beneficial Ownership Self-Assessment using the regional/deposit framework; (3) document that the income recipient has real economic substance (personnel, premises, business activity) and does not merely pass income to a third jurisdiction; (4) apply for the treaty-reduced rate through the electronic tax bureau prior to or upon the payment; and (5) retain all supporting documents for 10 years. The Chinese WFOE withholding agent must file VAT/CIT withholding declarations, pay the withheld amount within 7 days of the withholding obligation, and preserve a copy of the TRC in the underlying tax file.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Interest and royalty outbound payments are subject to the domestic statutory 10% withholding tax; a treaty may reduce interest to 5-10% and royalties to 5-10% depending on the jurisdiction. For the Hong Kong DTA, for example, interest is capped at 7% and royalties at 7% when the beneficial owner is a Hong Kong resident. The WFOE must nevertheless report the gross amount, apply the analysis, and substantiate that the royalty is for the genuine use of IP, trademarks, patents, or technical know-how related to the Montessori wooden-block design.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File mandatory when a single-year related-party transaction exceeds: RMB 200 million for tangible property; RMB 100 million for intangible property; RMB 100 million for financial assets; RMB 40 million for services; Master File mandatory when the aggregate cross-border related-party transaction exceeds RMB 1 billion. In all cases the annual related-party transaction schedule must be submitted regardless of threshold.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: China does not maintain a standalone Economic Substance Regulation regime like offshore financing centers, but the State Taxation Administration applies a substance-over-form doctrine, the Beneficial Ownership Standard, and the PRC General Anti-Avoidance Rule (GAAR) under Article 47 of the Enterprise Income Tax Law and its Implementation Rules. For a WFOE manufacturing toy blocks, the substantive test requires actual personnel, factory premises, production equipment, inventory control, sales functions, and decision-making in China; a non-resident parent that merely invoices through a Hong Kong or tax-haven entity with no local staff violates the economic substance standard, and Chinese-source profits may be recharacterized, treaty relief denied, and a 10% withholding applied to the deemed dividends.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE routes majority shares through a Hong Kong or tax-haven intermediary that has no office, no employees, and no substantive business activities, and the intermediary claims a reduced dividend rate (e.g., 5%) for outbound distributions while simply flowing the cash through to the ultimate parent.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Denial of the DTA benefit; imposition of the 10% domestic withholding rate on the entire accumulated dividend amount; interest under Article 32 and penalty of 50%-5 times of the evaded tax under Article 63 of the Tax Collection and Administration Law; the GAAR (EIT Law Article 47) authorizes tax authorities to aggregate and recharacterize the arrangement.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal civil liability for the unpaid withheld tax and penalties if the director knowingly implemented the sham structure; an exit ban (blacklisting) and asset freeze under the Tax Collection and Administration Law provisions for non-compliant legal representatives; imprisonment up to 7 years under the Criminal Law Article 201 if the tax evasion attributable to the scheme exceeds the criminal threshold.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Manipulation and Fictitious Inter company Pricing
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE sells wooden sensory toys to the overseas related distributor at artificially low prices (e.g., below third-party export prices or below manufacturing cost) to inaccurately shift profits out of China and avoid Chinese CIT.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Special Tax Investigation adjustment under income tax law with a 10% net-margin floor for reallocated profit; late-interest compounded daily; tax deficiency penalty from 50% to 5 times the evicted CIT; a 25% base-rate adjustment multiplier in serious cases; denial of double-taxation relief.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false transfer pricing statements may be personally liable to repay the underpaid tax plus interest; the responsible legal representative is subject to exit prohibition, personal asset preservation, and civil compensation claims by the Chinese tax collector; criminal liability is prosecuted under the Criminal Law Article 201 and Article 205 (fictitious invoices), carrying a maximum sentence of 7 years in prison.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Off-Book E-commerce Revenue and Payment-Rail Concealment
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE receives substantial sales proceeds from Amazon Pay, Stripe, or PayPal into overseas or personal accounts, fails to invoice the sales, understates the annual CIT return, and does not declare the related-party or foreign-asset status.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Civil tax fraud penalty of 50%-5 times the unpaid tax under Article 63 of the Tax Collection and Administration Law; the tax authority may also impose a late fee of 0.05% daily on the whole concealed period; where the concealed tax exceeds RMB 50,000 and comprises more than 10% of the payable tax, criminal tax evasion is a felony.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Legal representatives and responsible finance officers are exposed to severe personal liability: exit bans and blacklisting, freezing of personal accounts, civil restitution for the tax losses, and criminal imprisonment under Criminal Law Article 201 for up to 7 years, together with fines and confiscation of property derived from concealment.
